description: Prepare monthly pay apps from the schedule of values in SYS-01; email them to private owners; submit FC-1 invoices through the federal invoicing portal; record receipts in SYS-02
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $92,000 billed a month; one missed pay app cycle delays cash by a month; a misdirected payment of up to $78,000 is usually unrecoverable and close to a year of profit (FAR 52.232-33(e)(2) for federal EFT); owner trust
manual_workaround: Prepare pay apps from the last SYS-01 export and the schedule of values spreadsheet; deliver by hand or the owner's portal; confirm remittance details by phone to the number in the contract file
dependent_third_parties: SYS-01 vendor; accounting vendor; owners; federal paying office; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Project Manager and Estimator; Office Manager; office

description: Approve invoices against pay apps; collect lien waivers; prepare ACH batches in SYS-02; Owner releases them in the bank portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $55,000 a month to 25 subcontractors and suppliers; on FC-1, subcontractors must be paid within 7 days of the company's receipt of payment (FAR 52.232-27(c)(1)) with interest penalties; late payment invites liens and stops work
manual_workaround: Release a manual ACH from the last approved batch in the bank portal, or write checks; any changed bank details verified by phone first
dependent_third_parties: Accounting vendor; bank; subcontractors and suppliers

description: Drawings, RFIs, submittals, change orders, daily logs, and photos for 4 jobsites through SYS-01 and the jobsite tablets
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crews must build from current drawings; working from superseded sheets causes rework and safety issues; RFI and submittal turnaround times are contractual
manual_workaround: Printed current drawing sets in each storage container and truck; RFIs by phone, logged later
dependent_third_parties: SYS-01 vendor; architects and engineers; cellular carrier

description: Takeoffs, pricing, subcontractor quotes, and bid submission, including federal bids
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bid due times are fixed and late bids are rejected; the DoD bid expected in late 2026 is about 29% of a year's revenue; values apply in bid weeks (outside bid weeks the MTD is 72 hours)
manual_workaround: Estimate from the prior day's spreadsheets on the shared drive; submit from any clean device or deliver by hand
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; AI tool vendor (optional); SAM

description: Weekly payroll for 7 employees by direct deposit; weekly certified payrolls for FC-1; collect subcontractors' certified payrolls
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Employees are paid weekly; FAR 52.222-8(b)(1) requires weekly certified payrolls on FC-1 for the company and its subcontractors; missed pay harms workers
manual_workaround: Ask the payroll service to repeat the prior week's payroll; prepare the certified payroll form from paper time cards

description: Keep SAM registration and representations current; correspond with the Contracting Officer; submit certified payrolls and closeout documents; prepare the CMMC Level 1 self-assessment and SPRS entry
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: An expired or wrong SAM registration stops award and payment; a federal representation or affirmation must be accurate (32 CFR 170.22); Contracting Officer correspondence has contract deadlines
manual_workaround: Government portals are reachable from any clean device; keep signed copies of representations and correspondence on paper
dependent_third_parties: SAM and other government portals; outside counsel

description: HR and insurance files, bonds, contracts, safety records, and closeout documents on the shared drive
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records are needed within days, not hours; certified payroll records must be kept 3 years after completion (FAR 52.222-8(a))
manual_workaround: Request copies from the insurer, surety, and owners; restore from the cloud backup
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; backup service (MSP subcontractor); MSP
